mission.lanterna.inicio_green_1.title: The Call of Oa
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_1.desc: The ring streaked across the sky and chose you. It already knows the way: the autopilot is taking you to Oa, the Green Corps citadel, where the Central Battery lights up the sky. If the flight is interrupted, follow the HUD arrow or open the star map (J).
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_2.title: The Instructor
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_2.desc: At the citadel, a Veltari waits for recruits near the Central Battery. The Veltari have no mouths: they speak through thought.
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_2.talk: Welcome, recruit. The ring does not make mistakes: if it chose you, there is will in you. But will without focus is just noise. Let's train.
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_4.title: Before the Guardians
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_4.desc: The Instructor is satisfied. Now the Guardians of the Universe want to see you: the elders who keep the story of the Broken Heart. They stand on the platform south of the citadel.
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_3.title: First Constructs
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_3.desc: Every Lantern starts with the basics: a wall to protect and a laser to attack. Hold Z to open the construct wheel, pick one and use it with X (the laser stays on while you hold it). Then break three training dummies at the base.
mission.lanterna.inicio_green_4.talk: We were expecting you, Lantern. Listen: in the beginning there was a single Heart that felt everything at once. It broke, and each emotion fell onto a planet. From the crack came the Null, which feels nothing and erases everything. Only the White Ring, born from the seven fusion rings, can hurt it. Start with Odym: hope is the beginning of everything.
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_1.title: The Call of Korugar
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_1.desc: The yellow ring chose you and already shows the way home: Korugar, the world of Fear. Go up to space (above Y 330) and follow the HUD arrow, or use the star map (J) and the autopilot.
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_2.title: Ksskra
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_2.desc: On Korugar, look for Ksskra at the planet's base (near the Spectrum Forge).
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_2.talk: ...You didn't tremble when you arrived. Good. On Korugar, whoever frightens rules, and the yellow ring will teach you to use fear as a weapon. Start with the dummies back there.
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_4.title: The Guardian Envoy
mission.lanterna.inicio_yellow_4.desc: A Guardian of the Universe came to Korugar to talk to you: he waits on the emerald dais next to the base. The Guardians have a story to tell, and a request.

ritual.lanterna.odym.rule: Ritual of Hope: open sky, at night or in the rain, with full health.
ritual.lanterna.oa.rule: Ritual of Will: only whoever defeated the Broken Sentinel forges the green ring. Stand firm for 10 seconds.
ritual.lanterna.okaara.rule: Ritual of Avarice: 16 gold ingots as tribute, and no one within 32 blocks to share with.
ritual.lanterna.ysmault.rule: Ritual of Rage: it only forges for those who bleed (half health or less).
ritual.lanterna.zamaron.rule: Ritual of Love: another player or a pet of yours within 8 blocks.
ritual.lanterna.korugar.rule: Ritual of Fear: 10 seconds in darkness, without running away.
ritual.lanterna.nok.rule: Ritual of Compassion: no peaceful animal killed by you in the last 3 game days.
ritual.lanterna.ryut.rule: Ritual of Death: at death's door (2 hearts or less).
mission.lanterna.main_odym_1.title: Journey to Odym
mission.lanterna.main_odym_1.desc: Odym is an endless ocean with islands and plants that glow blue. It rains a lot, but after every rain a blue aurora heals whoever is outdoors.
mission.lanterna.main_odym_2.title: The Respect of the Aelinos
mission.lanterna.main_odym_2.desc: The Aelinos are the gentlest people of the Void: they heal the wounded and flee from any fight. The Grey Echoes are dimming the glow of their sea. Protect Odym.
mission.lanterna.main_odym_2.talk: A Lantern on Odym! The Echoes are dimming our sea... If you protect us, the Pearl of Tomorrow is yours. And Morrow... he was one of us. He lost hope. Help him.
mission.lanterna.main_odym_3.title: Pearl of Tomorrow
mission.lanterna.main_odym_3.desc: The Pearl of Tomorrow lies at the bottom of the sea: inside the giant shells and in veins in the rock. The Aelinos also trade pearls for fish. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_odym_4.title: Morrow
mission.lanterna.main_odym_4.desc: Morrow was an Aelino who lost hope. He spreads Gloom (growing slowness and weakness). In phase 2 he puts out the three Pearl Beacons of the arena: relight each one with a Pearl of Tomorrow so he takes damage again. Bring 4 pearls to the Challenge Altar in the arena (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_odym_5.title: The Blue Ring
mission.lanterna.main_odym_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Odym's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Hope: open sky, at night or in the rain, with full health. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_oa_1.title: Journey to Oa
mission.lanterna.main_oa_1.desc: Oa is the center of the Void: polished rock linked by green light and the giant Central Battery lighting up the sky. Everything is orderly and symmetrical.
mission.lanterna.main_oa_2.title: The Respect of the Veltari
mission.lanterna.main_oa_2.desc: The Veltari are the judges and teachers of the Corps. They respect duty: completed missions and Echoes defeated on Oa.
mission.lanterna.main_oa_2.talk: The Veltari are fair judges: do your duty and they will recognize you. The Broken Sentinel, our old guardian, was corrupted by the Null. Pass the trial and the Core of Will is yours.
mission.lanterna.main_oa_3.title: Star Jade
mission.lanterna.main_oa_3.desc: Star Jade forms straight veins in Oa's rock. The Veltari also trade jade for Merits. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_oa_4.title: The Broken Sentinel
mission.lanterna.main_oa_4.desc: The Broken Sentinel copies the last construct you used and turns it against you. At half health it splits into three smaller sentinels. Bring 4 Star Jades to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_oa_5.title: The Green Ring
mission.lanterna.main_oa_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Oa's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Will: only whoever defeated the Broken Sentinel forges the green ring. Stand firm for 10 seconds. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_1.title: Journey to Okaara
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_1.desc: Okaara is a desert of golden sand covered with vault-towers. The sun is huge, and at night the sand glitters with metal dust. Watch your pockets: the Ghallos steal.
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_2.title: The Respect of the Ghallos
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_2.desc: The Ghallos don't attack: they steal and run. Killing a thief returns the item, but the village turns hostile. They respect whoever pays: do business.
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_2.talk: Information is expensive, friend. But you look like a good payer... Mammok sleeps under the tallest tower and swallows everything that falls on the ground. Tip: don't drop anything. Oops, that one was free. Don't tell anyone.
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_3.title: Amber of Possession
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_3.desc: Amber of Possession only drops with an iron pickaxe or better. The Ghallos sell amber, but it's expensive (and the price goes up with each purchase). You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_4.title: Mammok
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_4.desc: Mammok sucks up items from the ground, and each one becomes armor. In phase 2 he spits treasure mixed with explosions. Don't drop anything during the fight. Bring 4 Amber of Possession to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_5.title: The Orange Ring
mission.lanterna.main_okaara_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Okaara's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Avarice: 16 gold ingots as tribute, and no one within 32 blocks to share with. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_1.title: Journey to Ysmault
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_1.desc: Ysmault is volcanic: blood-red rivers, a smoky sky and cracked basalt ground. Geysers burst out of nowhere.
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_2.title: The Respect of the Brakkari
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_2.desc: The Brakkari attack any stranger. But whoever beats one of them in a duel (leaves it at low health) earns everyone's respect: the loser kneels.
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_2.talk: You beat one of mine! Now you can walk on Ysmault. Vorgath waits in the arena. When his heart races, hit him head-on: that's where he bleeds.
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_3.title: Raw Wrath
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_3.desc: Raw Wrath beats like a heart inside the basalt. The Brakkari trade Wrath for bones and monster heads. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_4.title: Vorgath
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_4.desc: Vorgath charges and stomps, opening fire fissures. In phase 2 his heart races: every beat releases a shockwave, but head-on hits deal double damage. Bring 4 Raw Wrath to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_5.title: The Red Ring
mission.lanterna.main_ysmault_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Ysmault's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Rage: it only forges for those who bleed (half health or less). If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_1.title: Journey to Zamaron
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_1.desc: Zamaron has gardens of pink and violet crystal. It's beautiful... but up close, the crystal statues are trapped people.
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_2.title: The Respect of the Zaëlith
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_2.desc: The Zaëlith live in pairs, linked by a thread of light. Each one has a favorite gift: give it and their affection grows. Never attack a pair.
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_2.talk: You brought gifts... how kind. Our queen, Nyrielle, lost her partner and trapped the whole planet in devotion. The crystals around her are the loved ones she keeps. Free them.
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_3.title: Devoted Crystal
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_3.desc: Devoted Crystal only glows in company (another player or a tamed pet). It grows in veins and clusters across the gardens. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_4.title: Nyrielle
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_4.desc: Nyrielle summons crystal copies. The six crystals around the arena are the trapped loved ones: break them to weaken her. In phase 2 she traps you in crystal: break out fast. Bring 4 Devoted Crystals to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_5.title: The Violet Ring
mission.lanterna.main_zamaron_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Zamaron's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Love: another player or a pet of yours within 8 blocks. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_1.title: Journey to Korugar
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_1.desc: On Korugar the sun never fully rises. A yellow mist covers the ground and Dread grows in whoever stays outdoors: take shelter for it to pass.
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_2.title: The Respect of the Skrell'Vath
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_2.desc: The Skrell'Vath stalk from afar, put out torches and only attack from behind. Stare at one for 3 seconds without looking away and it backs off: they respect the fearless.
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_2.talk: You stared at me and didn't run. Rare. Thessara, our matriarch, creates shadows of herself. Look for the one that casts no shadow: that's the real one.
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_3.title: Dread Shard
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_3.desc: Dread Shards only appear in the deepest, darkest caves of Korugar. The Skrell'Vath trade shards for spider eyes. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_4.title: Thessara
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_4.desc: Thessara creates illusions of herself. Only the real one takes damage, and she's the only one that casts no shadow. In phase 2 she darkens everything and flies. Bring 4 Dread Shards to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_5.title: The Yellow Ring
mission.lanterna.main_korugar_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Korugar's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Fear: 10 seconds in darkness, without running away. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_nok_1.title: Journey to Nok
mission.lanterna.main_nok_1.desc: Nok is a jungle of giant purple trees, with ancient temples swallowed by the roots. The light comes and goes slowly, like breathing.
mission.lanterna.main_nok_2.title: The Respect of the Ves'Kai
mission.lanterna.main_nok_2.desc: The Ves'Kai are peaceful, but turn hostile if you hurt an innocent near them. They never trade item for item: only for deeds. Heal the wounded.
mission.lanterna.main_nok_2.talk: Thank you for looking after us. The Faceless Penitent carries all the pain it caused. Blows don't hurt it: heal the weeping faces and it will become vulnerable.
mission.lanterna.main_nok_3.title: Indigo Tear
mission.lanterna.main_nok_3.desc: Indigo Tears grow like drops on cave ceilings and in veins of the temple stone. The Ves'Kai trade tears for Gratitude. You need 4 to summon the boss and 4 for the forge.
mission.lanterna.main_nok_4.title: The Faceless Penitent
mission.lanterna.main_nok_4.desc: The Penitent takes no damage from normal attacks. Use healing items on it (golden apple, healing potion, Nok herb or the Staff of Compassion) to heal the faces: each healed face makes it more vulnerable. In phase 2 it really attacks and some faces start weeping again. Bring 4 Indigo Tears to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.main_nok_5.title: The Indigo Ring
mission.lanterna.main_nok_5.desc: At the Spectrum Forge of Nok's base: Empty Ring + the boss drop + 4 ores, and the ritual. Ritual of Compassion: no peaceful animal killed by you in the last 3 game days. If this ring is already yours, the mission completes itself.
mission.lanterna.main_genese_1.title: The Seven Rings
mission.lanterna.main_genese_1.desc: The Guardians' last secret: Genesis, the place where the Heart broke, only appears to whoever carries the seven fusion rings (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo and Violet) and the seven boss drops. Gather everything in your inventory.
mission.lanterna.main_genese_2.title: Genesis
mission.lanterna.main_genese_2.desc: A white nebula opened in the Void. Fly to Genesis: white grass, trees that bloom in seconds and glowing water.
mission.lanterna.main_genese_3.title: The Altar of Life
mission.lanterna.main_genese_3.desc: At the center of Genesis stands the Altar of Life. The seven rings and the seven drops merge and vanish: the White Ring is born, the most powerful of all. The Black Ring never enters (whoever carries it can't even touch the altar).
mission.lanterna.main_genese_4.title: The Null
mission.lanterna.main_genese_4.desc: Next to the altar is the grey rift. With the White Ring on, touch it and face the Null. Only Life hurts it. Phase 1: it drains the colors and summons Echoes. Phase 2: it copies a boss from each planet. Phase 3: it tries to close the rift with you inside.
mission.lanterna.ryut_1.title: The Silence of Ryut
mission.lanterna.ryut_1.desc: Ryut is a dead world: black ice, giant bones and silence. Food doesn't restore health here. Only one Silent One speaks to the living: the Collector.
mission.lanterna.ryut_1.talk: Souls... Bring souls. They come to those Death has touched. The Echo Devourer feeds on the memory of the dead: it will bring back everything you have ever beaten.
mission.lanterna.ryut_2.title: The Collector's Price
mission.lanterna.ryut_2.desc: The Collector only trades souls. Earn his respect and gather End Obsidian (deep veins in the black ice, or by trading souls).
mission.lanterna.ryut_3.title: The Echo Devourer
mission.lanterna.ryut_3.desc: A skeletal titan that revives the bosses you already defeated, as black echoes. In phase 2 it drains everyone's life: stay near the light of batteries (the arena's skulls or your battery in the slot with the ring on) to lose less. Bring 4 End Obsidian to the Challenge Altar (X 120, Z 0).
mission.lanterna.ryut_4.title: The Secret of the Silent
mission.lanterna.ryut_4.desc: Return to the Collector. The Black Ring is not forged by will: it chooses who dies. The Silent tell the secret to those who beat the Devourer.
mission.lanterna.patrulha.title: Sector Patrol
mission.lanterna.patrulha.desc: Grey Echoes are leaking from the Null's rift. Defeat 8 of them anywhere. Repeat as many times as you like.
mission.lanterna.abandoned: Mission abandoned: %s (the Veltari don't like that)
dialog.lanterna.brakkari.lider: I am Gorrak. This month, the strongest. Want to talk? Prove you can take a punch.
dialog.lanterna.brakkari.no_respect: (He clenches his fists. The Brakkari only respect whoever beats one of them in a duel.)
dialog.lanterna.ghallos.morador: Hello, hello! Everything for sale, everything on discount... for me.
dialog.lanterna.ghallos.lider: Pirrix, at your service. For a price, of course.
dialog.lanterna.skrell_vath.lider: Ksskra watches you. She already knows what you fear.
dialog.lanterna.skrell_vath.no_respect: (It won't trade with the fearful. Stare down a Skrell'Vath without looking away.)
dialog.lanterna.veltari.instrutor: Master Toran tilts his head. You hear his voice inside your mind.
dialog.lanterna.veltari.ignore: (The Veltari ignores you. They only deal with green ring bearers or those who proved their worth in missions.)
dialog.lanterna.aelinos.morador: ♪ Everything will be fine... everything will be fine... ♪
dialog.lanterna.aelinos.lider: Liel hums as she talks to you, and the water around glows brighter.
dialog.lanterna.ves_kai.morador: We felt you arrive. Be at peace.
dialog.lanterna.ves_kai.lider: I am Vael. Everyone here once caused pain. We came to learn how to feel it.
dialog.lanterna.ves_kai.wounded: This Ves'Kai is wounded. Maybe you can help: golden apple, healing potion, Nok herb or the staff.
dialog.lanterna.ves_kai.gesture: (You don't understand their language, but their gestures are calm and kind.)
dialog.lanterna.zaelith.morador: I'm so glad you came... stay a little longer.
dialog.lanterna.zaelith.lider: Seraphine and Auren, linked by a thread of light, look at you at the same time.
dialog.lanterna.zaelith.no_affection: (The Zaëlith only trade with those who have received affection: give gifts.)
dialog.lanterna.zaelith.mourning: (This Zaëlith lost its partner. Its gaze is now only crystal and rage.)
dialog.lanterna.silente.morador: (Silence. It repeats an ancient gesture, as if hammering an invisible anvil.)
dialog.lanterna.coletor.lider: The Collector tilts its hood. The soul jar glows faintly.
dialog.lanterna.guardiao.guardiao: Welcome to Oa, Lantern. The Broken Heart beats weaker every day.
boss.lanterna.vorgath.intro: The magma beast roars. The heart in its chest glows.
boss.lanterna.vorgath.phase2: Vorgath's heart is racing! Head-on hits deal double damage.
boss.lanterna.mammok.intro: The ground shakes. Something huge rises from the sand.
boss.lanterna.mammok.phase2: Mammok opens its mouth: treasure and explosions!
boss.lanterna.thessara.intro: A thousand shadows move. Only one is real.
boss.lanterna.thessara.phase2: The arena goes dark. Only her eyes glow.
boss.lanterna.vigia_partido.intro: The old guardian awakens, cracked by the Null.
boss.lanterna.vigia_partido.phase2: The Broken Sentinel splits into three!
boss.lanterna.morrow.intro: The sea turns grey wherever he passes.
boss.lanterna.morrow.phase2: The beacons went out! Relight all three with Pearls of Tomorrow.
boss.lanterna.penitente.intro: Weeping faces, trapped in a faceless body.
boss.lanterna.penitente.phase2: The Penitent is really attacking now!
boss.lanterna.nyrielle.intro: The crystal queen never lets go of what she loves.
boss.lanterna.nyrielle.phase2: Nyrielle tries to trap you in crystal!
boss.lanterna.devorador_de_ecos.intro: It remembers everything you have defeated.
boss.lanterna.devorador_de_ecos.phase2: The Devourer starts draining life! Stay near the light of the batteries.
boss.lanterna.nulo.intro: It feels nothing. Only Life hurts it.
boss.lanterna.nulo.phase2: The Null copies the powers of the colors!
boss.lanterna.nulo.phase3: The rift is closing with you inside!
boss.lanterna.mammok.swallow: Mammok swallowed an item and hardened (%s)
boss.lanterna.morrow.beacons: Morrow feels nothing while the beacons are out.
boss.lanterna.morrow.thanks: Morrow turns blue again for a moment: "...thank you. I had forgotten what it's like."
boss.lanterna.penitente.immune: Blows don't hurt it. Heal its faces with healing items.
boss.lanterna.nyrielle.freed: A loved one was freed from the crystal!
boss.lanterna.nyrielle.prison: Crystal prison! Break the blocks fast!
boss.lanterna.vigia_partido.recognized: The Veltari recognize you as a true Lantern.
boss.lanterna.nulo.immune: The Null feels nothing. Only the White Ring hurts it.
boss.lanterna.nulo.close: The rift closed for an instant!
boss.lanterna.nulo.defeated: The Null comes apart. The Primordial Heart beats again: everything in the Void feels once more.
message.lanterna.aelinos_heal: The Aelinos sing and your health returns

message.lanterna.altar_busy: There's already a fight going on here.
message.lanterna.altar_missing: The Altar of Life asks for the seven rings and the seven drops. Missing:

message.lanterna.altar_rejects_black: The Altar of Life repels the Black Ring!
message.lanterna.altar_wrong_place: This altar only works on the Corps planets.
message.lanterna.battery_already_upgrade: This battery has already been upgraded.
message.lanterna.battery_upgraded: Battery upgraded! The ring now holds 50% more charge.
message.lanterna.brakkari_duel_won: The Brakkari kneels. The Brakkari now respect you!
message.lanterna.construct_hesitates: The ring hesitates... it doesn't fully trust you yet.
message.lanterna.farol_needs_pearl: The beacon needs a Pearl of Tomorrow.
message.lanterna.forge_needs: The forge asks for: Empty Ring + %s + 4 %s.
message.lanterna.forge_wrong_place: The Spectrum Forge only works on the Corps planets.

message.lanterna.green_to_oa: The green ring already knows the way: off to Oa!
message.lanterna.leader_unharmed: He doesn't fight back. That's not the way.
message.lanterna.rift_needs_white: The rift doesn't respond. Only Life (the White Ring on) can open it.
message.lanterna.secret_scroll: The scroll reveals %s ores around you.
message.lanterna.skrell_recoil: The Skrell'Vath backs off. It respects the fearless.
message.lanterna.veskai_angry: The Ves'Kai saw you hurt an innocent!
message.lanterna.veskai_healed: The Ves'Kai gets up and thanks you with Gratitude.
planet.lanterna.odym.aurora: The blue aurora appears after the rain and heals you
ritual.lanterna.started: The ritual has begun. Stay near the forge!
ritual.lanterna.forged_sub: A new ring was born in the forge
message.lanterna.dormant_need_battery: The ring is dark. Use it on a placed Chiseled Battery.
message.lanterna.dormant_has_ring: You already have a ring. This one stays silent.
message.lanterna.dormant_awake: The Chiseled Battery cracks. Light flows into the ring... and it picks a color!
message.lanterna.call_sign: Out in space, a distant light noticed you... (%s/%s)
message.lanterna.call_answered: The rings heard your call. One of them is crossing space to reach you!
ritual.lanterna.call.title: The Call
ritual.lanterna.call.how: big achievements on Earth (diamonds, the Nether, enchanting, a fortress, Eye of Ender, the Dragon...) call a random ring. Signs: %s/%s
ritual.lanterna.fallen.title: The Fallen Ring
ritual.lanterna.fallen.how: find a meteor crater (smoke column, cartographer's map), take the Dormant Ring and use it on a Chiseled Battery: the ring picks a random Corps
selection.lanterna.reason.call: Your deeds on Earth reached far into space. The %s ring chose you.
selection.lanterna.reason.dormant: The battery's light woke the %s ring. Now it's yours, and you are its.
tooltip.lanterna.dormant_line1: Cold, dark, colorless. Not even it knows which Corps it belongs to.
tooltip.lanterna.dormant_line2: Craft a Chiseled Battery, place it and use the ring on it.
tooltip.lanterna.dormant_line3: The battery breaks and the ring picks a Corps for you (it starts at 10% charge).
message.lanterna.chiseled_battery_hint: A colorless battery. It only answers a Dormant Ring.
message.lanterna.ring_to_home: The ring already knows the way home: heading to %s!
dialog.lanterna.enemy_corps: You carry the light of a Corps my people see as an enemy. No one here will trade with you, and the young ones will want a fight. Prove your worth first.
dialog.lanterna.guardiao.emissario: No need to travel to Oa, Lantern: we came to you. Whatever the color of your light, the Broken Heart beats weaker every day.
journal.lanterna.passives: Ring on: +1 food every %ss · ½ heart every %ss · punch +%s · constructs x%s
message.lanterna.death_battery: Your battery stayed where you fell: %s, %s, %s (%s).
message.lanterna.death_ring_returns: The ring won't abandon you: it returns to your hand, but the trip cost energy. %s%% left.
message.lanterna.death_ring_lost: The ring was too weak to return. It stayed with the battery, where you fell.
npc.lanterna.fala.aliado.0: In the light of the Corps, Lantern! If you need help, just call.
npc.lanterna.fala.aliado.1: The pirates are getting bold in this sector. Keep an eye on space.
npc.lanterna.fala.aliado.2: The base's contract board has work for today.
npc.lanterna.fala.inimigo.0: You have the nerve to show up here with that color on your finger.
npc.lanterna.fala.inimigo.1: Get off my planet before I lose my patience.
npc.lanterna.fala.neutro.0: Hm. A different Corps. Tread carefully.
npc.lanterna.fala.neutro.1: We have no quarrel with your color. For now.
npc.lanterna.fala.neutro.2: If you see pirates, let us know.
item.lanterna.blaster_pirata.desc: Right click: fires a plasma shot.
item.lanterna.blaster_capitao.desc: Right click: an exploding plasma shot.
item.lanterna.chave_nave.desc: Only whoever has the key (or the owner) can fly the ship.
item.lanterna.fragmento_casco.desc: Click a ship to repair 20% of its hull.
item.lanterna.nucleo_propulsor.desc: An engine part. Used to build ships.
item.lanterna.contrato.desc: Take contracts from the board at the planet bases.
posto.lanterna.3.desc: Level 30. A veteran of the Corps.
posto.lanterna.4.desc: Level 40. The elite of the Corps.
item.lanterna.nave.desc: Click the ground to place the ship. It becomes yours and you get the key.
nave.lanterna.nao_e_sua: This ship has a crew. It isn't yours.
nave.lanterna.trancada: The ship is locked: you need the key.
nave.lanterna.sua_agora: The ship is yours! Keep the key.
nave.lanterna.controles: Piloting: WASD flies where you look · Space up · C down · Ctrl boost · X fire · B door · Shift exit
nivel.lanterna.precisa_forja: This ring only lets a Lantern of level %s or higher forge it.
tropa.lanterna.matou_inocente: You killed a merchant. The Corps don't forget that.
tropa.lanterna.resgatado: Thank you, Lantern! I couldn't have held out much longer.
encontro.lanterna.capitania: A pirate FLAGSHIP dropped out of hyperspace!
encontro.lanterna.patrulha: A patrol from your Corps is arriving
encontro.lanterna.cargueiro: A merchant freighter wants to trade
encontro.lanterna.mercador_fala: Merchant: Welcome aboard our counter! Take a look at the goods.
encontro.lanterna.saudacao.0: Sector clear, Lantern. We'll escort you for a while.
encontro.lanterna.saudacao.1: May the light of the Corps guide your route!
encontro.lanterna.saudacao.2: Pirates were seen around here. Stay alert.

contrato.lanterna.capitao.title: The Captain of %s
contrato.lanterna.capitao.desc: A pirate captain hides on %1$s. Defeat him; his ship goes to the winner. (%4$s XP)
contrato.lanterna.ecos.title: Echo Nest on %s
contrato.lanterna.ecos.desc: Grey Echoes gathered on %1$s. Defeat %2$s. (%4$s XP)
contrato.lanterna.invasores.title: Invaders on %s
contrato.lanterna.invasores.desc: Lanterns from an enemy Corps invaded %1$s. Drive out %2$s of them. (%4$s XP)
contrato.lanterna.resgate.title: Rescue on %s
contrato.lanterna.resgate.desc: A wounded Lantern called for help on %1$s, surrounded by Echoes. Reach him and talk to him. (%4$s XP)

prova.lanterna.concluida: The Trial of Emotion is over. Your ring now recharges with what you feel.
mission.lanterna.treino_5.title: Training: level 5
mission.lanterna.treino_5.desc: The next step of the Path of White needs a level 5 Lantern. Gain experience: base contract boards, city missions, space pirates, invaders and new planets.
mission.lanterna.treino_8.title: Training: level 8
mission.lanterna.treino_8.desc: The next step of the Path of White needs a level 8 Lantern. Gain experience: base contract boards, city missions, space pirates, invaders and new planets.
mission.lanterna.treino_12.title: Training: level 12
mission.lanterna.treino_12.desc: The next step of the Path of White needs a level 12 Lantern. Gain experience: base contract boards, city missions, space pirates, invaders and new planets.

mission.lanterna.main_genese_0.title: The Oath of Life
mission.lanterna.main_genese_0.desc: The Guardians only open the way to Genesis to those who proved Life beats Death: reach level 46, defeat 25 enemy Lanterns and 10 Pirate Captains, and hand 32 Merits to the Council.
mission.lanterna.ryut_4.talk: You want the ring of Death? No one takes it. It comes when you fall... and you never come back the same. Pray it never comes for you.
mission.lanterna.morte_1.title: The Whisper
mission.lanterna.morte_1.desc: You died, and your ring came back different: cold, heavy, whispering. Only the Silent of Ryut understand. Go to Ryut and speak with the Collector.
mission.lanterna.morte_1.talk: So it touched you. Death asks no permission, Lantern. Your ring is hungry now. Feed it, or it will consume you.
mission.lanterna.morte_2.title: Harvest
mission.lanterna.morte_2.desc: The corrupted ring tears the soul out of everything you kill. Defeat 60 creatures and gather 24 Souls.
mission.lanterna.morte_3.title: The Silent
mission.lanterna.morte_3.desc: The Silent only teach those they respect. Reach level 25 and earn their respect (6) — the Collector counts as one of them.
mission.lanterna.morte_4.title: The Dead Walk
mission.lanterna.morte_4.desc: Enemy Lanterns smell the corrupted ring and hunt you. Defeat 15 of them and gather 12 End Obsidian.
mission.lanterna.morte_5.title: The Collector's Price
mission.lanterna.morte_5.desc: The Collector trades secrets for relics. Gather 3 Relics (he trades 12 souls for one) and another 32 Souls.
mission.lanterna.morte_6.title: The Devourer
mission.lanterna.morte_6.desc: Only who devours the memory of the dead masters Death. Reach level 35, defeat 6 Pirate Captains and beat the Echo Devourer in Ryut's arena.
mission.lanterna.morte_7.title: The Seven Tombs
mission.lanterna.morte_7.desc: Death is everywhere. Visit Odym, Okaara, Zamaron and Nok, defeat 150 creatures and gather 48 Souls.
mission.lanterna.morte_8.title: Master Death
mission.lanterna.morte_8.desc: Reach level 42 and forge the Black Ring at Ryut's Spectral Forge: Empty Ring + End Core + 4 End Obsidian, at death's door (2 hearts or less). Only those who walked this path can.
mission.lanterna.morte_ceifa.title: Reap
mission.lanterna.morte_ceifa.desc: The Black Lantern's duty: bring death to another ring bearer. Whoever you defeat may have their ring corrupted. Go days without reaping and your ring weakens.
morte.lanterna.fome: Your ring is hungry. Without bringing death to another ring bearer, its power fades.
morte.lanterna.ceifou: You reaped %s. Death is satisfied... for now.
morte.lanterna.corrompido_1: ☠ Your ring came back from death... different.
morte.lanterna.corrompido_2: It is cold, heavy, and it whispers. Seek the Silent of Ryut.
morte.lanterna.aviso_servidor: A chill crosses the Void. Somewhere, a ring was touched by Death.
morte.lanterna.negro_ergueu: ☠ A Black Lantern has risen: %s. Death now walks among you.
morte.lanterna.dever: Your duty: bring death to other ring bearers. Whoever you defeat may be corrupted. Go %s days without reaping and the ring weakens.
morte.lanterna.forja_recusa: Ryut's forge stays cold. The Black Ring is not forged by will: it chooses who dies.
guilda.lanterna.min.melhoria: Level %s: %s essences, %s diamonds, %s Merits, %s netherite ingots
guilda.lanterna.tropa_inimiga: ⚔ The %s is now your enemy. Its Lanterns will attack you and its cities will refuse you.
guilda.lanterna.propria_tropa: A planet of your own Corps: you cannot invade it.
cidade.lanterna.recusa_traidor: You attacked one of our planets. You are not welcome here.
construct.lanterna.ariete.desc: Green ring only. A giant wedge of will that pierces everything in a straight line, flinging every enemy in its path.
construct.lanterna.pavor.desc: Yellow ring only. A blast of fear around you: those hit get Fear — players can't make constructs and their screen shakes; creatures flee.
construct.lanterna.napalm.desc: Red ring only. Hold: a cone of rage plasma that burns everything in front (fire and continuous damage).
construct.lanterna.esperanca.desc: Blue ring only. Heals you and nearby allies, grants Regeneration and removes Fear. Hurts undead and Black Lanterns.
construct.lanterna.cristal.desc: Violet ring only. Traps the target in a crystal; when it breaks the target is Charmed — creatures stop fighting, players get weak.
construct.lanterna.teleporte.desc: Indigo ring only. Teleports where you look; anyone near the arrival feels the pain they caused (nausea and weakness).
construct.lanterna.avareza.desc: Orange ring only. Up to 4 claws grab nearby enemies and drain their life to you — and other Lanterns' ring charge.
construct.lanterna.ceifa.desc: Black Ring only. Bone hands rise from the ground where you look: they hold, wither and give the life back to you.
construct.lanterna.vida.desc: White Ring only. A wave of life: heals and shields allies, clears bad effects and crushes enemies (double damage to undead and Black Lanterns).
message.lanterna.pavor_trava: Fear locks your will: no construct comes out!

mission.lanterna.portal_1.title: The Call of the Door
mission.lanterna.portal_1.desc: Your ring is strong and in tune with you. The Guardians of Oa want to teach what few Lanterns know: opening a door through the Void. Go to the Guardian of Oa.
mission.lanterna.portal_1.talk: A ring is not just a weapon, Lantern. It is a key. To open paths through the Void you must feel the path first: visit Odym, Korugar and Zamaron, and return when the ring is one with you.
mission.lanterna.portal_2.title: The Paths of the Void
mission.lanterna.portal_2.desc: Visit Odym, Korugar and Zamaron so the ring learns the paths. You must be level 32 with Trusted affinity.
mission.lanterna.portal_3.title: The First Door
mission.lanterna.portal_3.desc: Return to the Guardian of Oa. He will show how the ring draws the door.
mission.lanterna.portal_3.talk: Stretch out your arm. Picture the place, not the path. The ring draws the frame, your will opens the rest. Now you carry the Void in your hand.
autopilot.lanterna.cancel_hint: S: cancel  ·  V: stop flying  ·  J: map

perfil.lanterna.mascara_dica: Move the mask up or down so it sits over your skin's eyes. Everyone sees it.

juramento.lanterna.verde.1: Where there are walls, I will be the bridge.
juramento.lanterna.verde.2: Where there is fear, I will stand.
juramento.lanterna.verde.3: My will is the light that does not go out,
juramento.lanterna.verde.4: and the green Source burns while I breathe.
prova.lanterna.verde.desc: Three waves of enemies will attack the Battery. Stay inside the plaza circle (up to 16 blocks) and do not retreat until all three are beaten.
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_1.title: The Call of the Source: Lantern of Will
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_1.desc: The Central Battery of Oa has felt your ring. Before it opens the Source of Will, it wants to know if you are worthy: a ring bonded to you, experience, the respect of the planet's people and the blessing of those who guard the Battery.
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_2.title: The Trial of Will
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_2.desc: Go to the Central Battery plaza in the people's city and click the Battery to begin the trial. Three waves of enemies will attack the Battery. Stay inside the plaza circle (up to 16 blocks) and do not retreat until all three are beaten.
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_3.title: The Oath of Will
mission.lanterna.fonte_verde_3.desc: The Battery accepted your trial. Click it once more and take the Corps oath: it is what engraves the Source Seal on your ring.
objective.lanterna.fonte.verde.prova: Win the trial at the Battery plaza
objective.lanterna.fonte.verde.juramento: Take the oath before the Battery
juramento.lanterna.amarelo.1: I look into the depths of darkness and it backs away.
juramento.lanterna.amarelo.2: The fear around me now obeys me.
juramento.lanterna.amarelo.3: Let those who break the order tremble,
juramento.lanterna.amarelo.4: for the yellow Source sees through my eyes.

juramento.lanterna.vermelho.3: I am the rage that does not bow,
juramento.lanterna.vermelho.4: and the red Source burns in my chest.

juramento.lanterna.laranja.2: I keep what the universe forgot.
juramento.lanterna.laranja.3: What is mine will never be taken,
juramento.lanterna.laranja.4: and the orange Source is my treasure.
prova.lanterna.laranja.desc: The Battery asks for what you hold most dear. Click it while holding the offering within 2 minutes.

juramento.lanterna.azul.2: I carry the light of those who no longer believe.
juramento.lanterna.azul.3: While I am here, nothing is lost,
juramento.lanterna.azul.4: and the blue Source will never stop shining.
prova.lanterna.azul.desc: Pirates will attack three Aelinos in the plaza. Protect them for 90 seconds: at least two must survive.

juramento.lanterna.indigo.2: My hand reaches out even to the enemy.
juramento.lanterna.indigo.4: and the indigo Source heals through me.

construct.lanterna.r_erupcao.desc: Plasma columns burst from the ground where you look, for 6 s.

construct.lanterna.r_couraca.desc: A carapace of thorns returns part of the damage to whoever hits you.
construct.lanterna.o_moedas.desc: A volley of razor-sharp coins of light.
construct.lanterna.o_garra.desc: A claw grabs the target, pulls it in and steals life and charge.
construct.lanterna.o_mina.desc: A fake treasure on the ground explodes when an enemy comes near.
construct.lanterna.o_vortice.desc: A devouring whirlpool pulls in and hurts everything around for 6 s.
construct.lanterna.o_sanguessuga.desc: A leech of light latches onto enemies and sends their life to you.
construct.lanterna.o_tentaculos.desc: Tentacles burst from the ground and grab everything in the area.
construct.lanterna.o_cofre.desc: Locks the target in a vault of solid light for 6 s.
construct.lanterna.o_avatar.desc: A huge beast of avarice devours enemies for 20 s.
construct.lanterna.o_ima.desc: Pulls every item and enemy around you close.
construct.lanterna.o_coroa.desc: A crown of light: absorption, luck and items come to you for 30 s.
construct.lanterna.b_raio.desc: A ray pierces the whole line; it burns undead twice as hard.
construct.lanterna.b_estrela.desc: A homing star chases the target and bursts in light.
construct.lanterna.b_aurora.desc: Beams of light fall from the sky: they heal allies and hurt enemies.
construct.lanterna.b_cura.desc: A wave of light heals you and the allies around you.
construct.lanterna.b_egide.desc: Shields of light cover you and nearby allies: absorption and resistance.
construct.lanterna.b_asas.desc: Wings of light: speed, high jumps and slow falling for 30 s.
construct.lanterna.b_renascer.desc: For 60 s, the first death does not happen: you rise again with health.
construct.lanterna.b_anjo.desc: An angel of light heals you and attacks enemies for 25 s.
construct.lanterna.b_santuario.desc: A sacred circle heals allies and repels enemies for 12 s.
construct.lanterna.b_purificar.desc: A wave cleanses allies of harmful effects and hurts the dark.
construct.lanterna.i_olhar.desc: A ray that makes the target feel the pain it caused: confusion and weakness.
construct.lanterna.i_bastao.desc: Two staves spin around you for 10 s, striking and pushing.
construct.lanterna.i_troca.desc: You swap places with the target, leaving it dizzy.
construct.lanterna.i_lagrimas.desc: Tears of light fall: they heal allies and weaken enemies.
construct.lanterna.i_elo.desc: Binds you to the target: the damage it deals comes back to it.
construct.lanterna.i_raizes.desc: Roots hold enemies in the area for 4 s.
construct.lanterna.i_espirito.desc: A spirit of Nok floats with you: it heals and stuns enemies for 25 s.
construct.lanterna.i_silencio.desc: A wave of silence: enemies lose their target, slow down and cannot use powers.
construct.lanterna.i_toque.desc: Heals you and your allies and calms the enemies around.
construct.lanterna.i_espelho.desc: For 15 s, whoever hurts you feels the same pain.
construct.lanterna.v_flecha.desc: A crystal arrow that charms the target.
construct.lanterna.v_lanca.desc: A crystal lance pierces everyone in a line.
construct.lanterna.v_laco.desc: Ribbons of light spin around you for 12 s, cutting whoever comes close.
construct.lanterna.v_paixao.desc: A crystal burst hurts and charms everything around.
construct.lanterna.v_jardim.desc: Crystals sprout from the ground and hold enemies in the area.
construct.lanterna.v_abraco.desc: The target is held in crystal and you recover health while it is.
construct.lanterna.v_cavaleiro.desc: A crystal knight protects you for 25 s.
construct.lanterna.v_coracoes.desc: Hearts fall: they heal allies and charm enemies.
construct.lanterna.v_ninho.desc: A ring of crystal walls surrounds you.
construct.lanterna.v_par.desc: Protects you and the nearest ally: resistance and regeneration.

arvore.lanterna.passiva.duracao1.desc: Constructs, summons and effects last 30% longer.

arquivo.lanterna.verde.1:
Memory of Kheru, the First Sentinel.

In the beginning, Will was not a light: it was a weight only the stubborn could carry.
arquivo.lanterna.verde.2: Kheru stood on a collapsing bridge for three days, holding it with her mind, until the last refugee crossed.
arquivo.lanterna.verde.3: When the Guardians asked how, she said: 'I did not know I was allowed to stop.'
arquivo.lanterna.verde.4: Since then, every green ring holds a little of that bridge. Whoever gives up too early feels the ring grow heavy.
arquivo.lanterna.verde.5: The Jade Colossus sleeps on the Heart Island. It is Will with no one to guide it. Defeat it and it learns your name.
arquivo.lanterna.amarelo.1:
Record of Watcher Orrun.

Fear is the oldest emotion. Before loving or hating, every creature was afraid.
arquivo.lanterna.amarelo.2: Orrun did not use Fear to wound. He used it to remind: 'This could happen. Prepare.'
arquivo.lanterna.amarelo.3: The Lanterns who were lost were those who forgot to fear themselves.
arquivo.lanterna.amarelo.4: Yellow light shows the shadow of every thing. Whoever learns to read shadows is never caught off guard.
arquivo.lanterna.amarelo.5: The Mother of Shadows guards this Source's Heart. She does not hate you: she only wants you afraid forever.
arquivo.lanterna.vermelho.1:
Ashes of Varek, the Sworn.

Rage is born from an injustice no one mended.
arquivo.lanterna.vermelho.2: Varek burned for a hundred years, until he saw the fire warmed no one but himself.
arquivo.lanterna.vermelho.3: In the end, he learned to aim Rage: at the chain that binds, never at the one who is bound.
arquivo.lanterna.vermelho.4: The red Source's blood is too hot for the undecided. Decide who you fight for before you enter.
arquivo.lanterna.vermelho.5: The Scarlet Serpent coils around the Heart. It is Rage that never found a target. Give it one: you.
arquivo.lanterna.laranja.1:
Inventory of Thal-Morro, the Last Merchant.

All that I had, I counted. All that I counted, I lost.
arquivo.lanterna.laranja.2: Avarice is not wanting much. It is being unable to stop wanting.
arquivo.lanterna.laranja.3: Thal-Morro kept a thousand constructs inside his ring, each one a person he would not let go.
arquivo.lanterna.laranja.4: Whoever wields orange light must learn to give one thing a day. Otherwise the light begins to keep you.
arquivo.lanterna.laranja.5: The Starving King eats his own crown and is still hungry. He is waiting for you on the Heart Island.
arquivo.lanterna.azul.1:
Song of Lio, who lit the first blue star.

Hope is not believing it will work out.
arquivo.lanterna.azul.2: It is to keep doing the right thing without knowing whether it will work out.
arquivo.lanterna.azul.3: Lio healed whole worlds, but blue light alone does not ignite. It needs someone with Will nearby.
arquivo.lanterna.azul.4: That is why Hope walks beside Will. One promises, the other delivers.
arquivo.lanterna.azul.5: The Archangel of Dawn watches the Heart. Its light is so bright it blinds. Learn to look through it.
arquivo.lanterna.indigo.1:
(without words)

Indigo Lanterns barely speak. This book was written by those who listened to them.
arquivo.lanterna.indigo.2: Compassion is feeling another's pain as your own, and still not running away.
arquivo.lanterna.indigo.3: It is said the first Indigo carried a staff made from a branch of the garden where she lost everything.
arquivo.lanterna.indigo.4: She did not take revenge. She planted another garden. Indigo light grows that way: slowly, like a root.
arquivo.lanterna.indigo.5: The Serene Stag sleeps at the Heart. It does not wish to fight. But it will let no one without compassion through.
arquivo.lanterna.violeta.1:
Letters from Ysel to the one she loved.

Love is the strongest emotion and the most dangerous.
arquivo.lanterna.violeta.2: It protects with crystal, but crystal cuts whoever grips too tightly.
arquivo.lanterna.violeta.3: Ysel crossed three galaxies to fetch someone who did not want to be fetched. She came back alone, and wiser.
arquivo.lanterna.violeta.4: To love is to let the other choose. Violet light only obeys those who understand that.
arquivo.lanterna.violeta.5: The Crystal Queen guards the Heart. She loves so much she would trap the whole world in a jewel. Break free of her.
chefe.lanterna.supremo: %s gathers all of its emotion! Get away!
